'''KU-Cass''' is an NPC in [[Tethys Hub]], [[The Black Shores]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|KU-Cass}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Chat)
:'''KU-Cass:''' I should really figure out a good way to keep them safe onceall the cartridges are back with me.
:{{DIcon}} Why don't you just make them digital?
:'''KU-Cass:''' Nonsense! It's the tradition! Plus, I've recently found that some even have voice recordings attached. Like this one...
:{{DIcon}} What does it say?
:You wait patiently for something to happen as KU-Cass loads the cartridge's data.
:{{DIcon}} Anything?
:'''KU-Cass:''' Er... The cartridge seems to have jammed itself. Luckily, I caught the last sentence—it looks like a message from the game's creator...
:'''KU-Cass:''' Thank you for enjoying my game...
{{Dialogue End}}
